note: Project/PR descriptions are provenance records; they do not by themselves upgrade external-demand claims.

pull_requests.title: Establish Open System One foundation v0.1
pull_requests.pre_state: Research components are fragmented and lack one typed foundation surface.
pull_requests.target_state: Typed decision contract, replaceable backend, deterministic evaluation, evidence ledger and CI-backed research foundation exist.
pull_requests.desired_delta: A reproducible research/control surface exists instead of ad hoc components.

pull_requests.title: Recover v0.3 research frontier and executable capabilities
pull_requests.pre_state: Earlier v0.3-stage capabilities/receipts are absent from the minimal foundation.
pull_requests.target_state: Recoverable research capabilities and their evidence/guardrails are represented and executable.
pull_requests.desired_delta: Historical research state becomes an auditable executable surface without claiming Jev reproduction or production calibration.
pull_requests.evidence_boundary: PR description reports 31 passed in 2.24s and 33 passed in 2.01s; this record treats those as PR_REPORTED until independently re-executed.

pull_requests.title: Research: self-conversion primitive and MCP REST bridge
pull_requests.pre_state: A self-conversion/MCP-to-REST path is not represented as a bounded test artifact.
pull_requests.target_state: The path is represented by a focused proof artifact with integration tests and no production-autonomy claim.
pull_requests.desired_delta: The research question becomes executable and inspectable rather than conceptual.

pull_requests.title: Extract standalone Hamiltonian verifier
pull_requests.pre_state: The verifier is embedded in Symlib and a first extraction used the wrong axis/colour relation.
pull_requests.target_state: Standalone verifier preserves the source predicate, rejects the known mutated case, and avoids a Symlib runtime dependency.
pull_requests.desired_delta: Verified legacy predicate extraction becomes independently usable while generalized correctness remains open.
pull_requests.evidence_boundary: PR description reports canonical/exhaustive/source-derived checks and explicit superseded commits.

pull_requests.title: research: transition-centered opportunity representation v0.3
pull_requests.pre_state: Opportunity research is organized around problem/tool candidates.
pull_requests.target_state: Opportunity research is represented as state transitions with explicit mechanisms, oracles and lineage.
pull_requests.desired_delta: Transition becomes the primary research object without erasing problem/evidence history.

current_project_transitions.pre_state: Research/execution/evidence are distributed across projects and experiments.
current_project_transitions.target_state: Common lineage connects source records, transitions, executions, evidence and decisions.
